source_units.text: I want to work through a beginner Go problem booklet.
Help me divide the life-and-death study into small sessions.
Use only dates from 2027-02-01 through 2027-02-06, including the final date.
I can spare at most 65 minutes per day, counting every topic together.
Include "Eye Formation", "Capturing Races", "Seki", using those topic names.
Allocate at least 20 cumulative minutes to every topic.
Within that coverage, "Eye Formation" needs at least 30 total minutes.
